reason: I'd grab the 7-day free trial and then live on the 3 free fragments a day. In a noisy marshrutka I'm not sure it'll even hear me properly, and I'm not paying until I see it doesn't glitch.
objection: On the bus it'll either not catch my voice or give random scores. And it only checks pronunciation, while my real problem at IELTS is grammar and vocabulary.
would_change_my_mind: If during the trial it really caught my mistakes accurately even with background noise, and then there was a discount on the yearly plan, around $19.99.
